spans.s:
Bodha is the name of a ṛṣi in the mantra Pāṭha. He is mentioned with Pratibodha in the Atharvaveda, but Whitney thinks that in the second passage, at least, the word is an ordinary noun meaning ‘the wakeful one.’
Foot notes ii. 16, 14. Cf. Winternitz, Mantrapāṭha, xiv.
v. 30, 10; viii. 1, 13.
Translation of the Atharvaveda, 474.
